issues.description: The createPerson REST endpoint has different return types between the template and the solution. In the template PersonResource.createPerson returns ResponseEntity<Person>, while in the solution the same endpoint is declared as void. This inconsistency in method signature may confuse students about the expected controller contract and what to return from the POST /persons endpoint.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the createPerson endpoint signature consistent across template and solution. Either change the solution to return ResponseEntity<Person> with the saved person (recommended), or change the template to use void and document that the endpoint returns an empty 200 response. Update any tests and documentation accordingly so students see a single consistent expected controller contract.
